name: unusual-whales
description: Connect to the official Unusual Whales market-data MCP server using each user's own API key.

interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the official Unusual Whales remote MCP server. Each user supplies their own UW_API_KEY locally; the key is not included in this package.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Unusual Whales MCP tools to research a market-data question. Separate observations from inference and do not place trades.
